name: Ozu Asao
source:
A member of the Tenryu-gumi yakuza syndicate. The Tenryu-gumi operates a lending firm called Takarada Financing, and he's been tasked with collecting outstanding debts alongside his underling [url=/c93375]Yutaro Segawa[/url]. They've already collected from one client today.

Ozu is quite frightening when angry —his nickname is "Ozu the Ogre"— but despite his strong emotions he is very logic-driven.

[Edited from in-game TIPS]
